I am knowledge of the Self among all branches of knowledge. I am the argument of dators. I am the logic of…

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text:
।।10.32।। व्याख्या--'सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहम्'--जितने सर्ग और महासर्ग होते हैं अर्थात् जितने प्राणियोंकी उत्पत्ति होती है, उनके आदिमें भी मैं रहता हूँ, उनके मध्यमें भी मैं रहता हूँ और उनके अन्तमें (उनके लीन होनेपर) भी मैं रहता हूँ। तात्पर्य है कि सब कुछ वासुदेव ही है। अतः मात्र संसारको, प्राणियोंको देखते ही भगवान्की याद आनी चाहिये।

'अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानाम्'--जिस विद्यासे मनुष्यका कल्याण हो जाता है, वह अध्यात्मविद्या कहलाती है (टिप्पणी प0 562)। दूसरी सांसारिक कितनी ही विद्याएँ पढ़ लेनेपर भी पढ़ना बाकी ही रहता है परन्तु इस अध्यात्मविद्याके प्राप्त होनेपर पढ़ना अर्थात् जानना बाकी नहीं रहता। इसलिये भगवान्ने इसको अपनी विभूति बताया है।

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 10.32 सर्गाणाम् among creations? आदिः the beginning? अन्तः the end? च and? मध्यम् the middle? च and? एव also? अहम् I? अर्जुन O Arjuna? अध्यात्मविद्या the science of the Self? विद्यानाम् among sciences? वादः logic? प्रवदताम् among controversialists? अहम् I.Commentary I am the metaphysics among all sciences. I am knowledge of the Self among all branches of knowledge. I am the argument of dators. I am the logic of disputants. I am the speech of orators.In verse 20 above the Lord says? I am the beginning? the middle and the end of the whole movable and immovable creation. Here the whole creation in general is referred to.As the knowledge of the Self leads to the attainment of the final beatitude of life or salvation? it is the chief among all branches of knowledge.Pravadatam By the word controversialists? we should here understand the various kinds of people using various kinds of…

verses.title: Verse 405
verses.sanskrit:
अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि द्वन्द्वः सामासिकस्य च।

अहमेवाक्षयः कालो धाताऽहं विश्वतोमुखः।।10.33।।
verses.transliteration:
अहमेवाक्षय: कालो धाताहं विश्वतोमुख: || 33||

akṣharāṇām a-kāro ’smi dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya cha
aham evākṣhayaḥ kālo dhātāhaṁ viśhvato-mukhaḥ
verses.wordMeanings: akṣharāṇām—amongst all letters; a-kāraḥ—the beginning letter “A”; asmi—I am; dvandvaḥ—the dual; sāmāsikasya—amongst grammatical compounds; cha—and; aham—I; eva—only; akṣhayaḥ—endless; kālaḥ—time; dhātā—amongst the creators; aham—I; viśhwataḥ-mukhaḥ—Brahma

translations.hindi: ।।10.33।। मैं अक्षरों (वर्णमाला) में अकार और समासों में द्वन्द्व (नामक समास) हूँ; मैं अक्षय काल और विश्वतोमुख (विराट् स्वरूप) धाता हूँ।।
translations.english: Of letters, I am the alphabet 'A'; of compound words, I am the dvandva (copulative); I am myself imperishable time; I am the creator, facing all sides.

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।10.33।। अक्षरोंमें अकार और समासोंमें द्वन्द्व समास मैं हूँ। अक्षयकाल अर्थात् कालका भी महाकाल तथा सब ओर मुखवाला धाता भी मैं हूँ।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।10.33।। मैं अक्षरों (वर्णमाला) में अकार और समासों में द्वन्द्व (नामक समास) हूँ; मैं अक्षय काल और विश्वतोमुख (विराट् स्वरूप) धाता हूँ।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: Of letters, I am the alphabet 'A'; of compound words, I am the dvandva (copulative); I am myself imperishable time; I am the creator, facing all sides.

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: Of the letters, I am the letter A, and of the group of compound words, I am the compound called Dvandva. I am Myself the infinite time; I am the Dispenser with faces everywhere.

verses.editorialSummary: Of letters, I am the alphabet 'A'; of compound words, I am the dvandva (copulative); I am myself imperishable time; I am the creator, facing all sides.
verses.commentary: 10.33 अक्षराणाम् among letters? अकारः the letter A? अस्मि (I) am? द्वन्द्वः the dual? सामासिकस्य among all compounds? च and? अहम् I? एव verily? अक्षयः the inexhaustible or everlasting? कालः time? धाता the dispenser? अहम् I? विश्वतोमुखः the Allfaced (or having faces in all directions).Commentary Among the alphabets I am the letter A. Among the various kinds of compounds used in Sanskrit language I am the Dvandva…

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text: ।।10.33।। व्याख्या--'अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि'--वर्णमालामें सर्वप्रथम अकार आता है। स्वर और व्यञ्जन--दोनोंमें अकार मुख्य है। अकारके बिना व्यञ्जनोंका उच्चारण नहीं होता। इसलिये अकारको भगवान्ने अपनी विभूति बताया है।

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 10.33 अक्षराणाम् among letters? अकारः the letter A? अस्मि (I) am? द्वन्द्वः the dual? सामासिकस्य among all compounds? च and? अहम् I? एव verily? अक्षयः the inexhaustible or everlasting? कालः time? धाता the dispenser? अहम् I? विश्वतोमुखः the Allfaced (or having faces in all directions).Commentary Among the alphabets I am the letter A. Among the various kinds of compounds used in Sanskrit language I am the Dvandva (union of the two)? the copulative.Time here refers to the moment? the ultimate element of time or to Paramesvara? the Supreme Lord Who is the time of even time? since He is beyond time.As the Supreme Being is allpervading it is said that He has faces in all directions.

verses.title: Verse 406
verses.sanskrit:
मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम्।

कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा।।10.34।।
verses.transliteration:
mṛityuḥ sarva-haraśh chāham udbhavaśh cha bhaviṣhyatām
kīrtiḥ śhrīr vāk cha nārīṇāṁ smṛitir medhā dhṛitiḥ kṣhamā
verses.wordMeanings: mṛityuḥ—death; sarva-haraḥ—all-devouring; cha—and; aham—I; udbhavaḥ—the origin; cha—and; bhaviṣhyatām—those things that are yet to be; kīrtiḥ—fame; śhrīḥ—prospective; vāk—fine speech; cha—and; nārīṇām—amongst feminine qualities; smṛitiḥ—memory; medhā—intelligence; dhṛitiḥ—courage; kṣhamā—forgiveness

translations.hindi: ।।10.34।। मैं सर्वभक्षक मृत्यु और भविष्य में होने वालों की उत्पत्ति का कारण हूँ; स्त्रियों में कीर्ति, श्री, वाक (वाणी), स्मृति, मेधा, धृति और क्षमा हूँ।।
translations.english: I am also death, which snatches away all. I am the origin of all that will be born. Among women, I am fame, prosperity, speech, memory, intelligence, endurance, and forgiveness.

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।10.34।। सबका हरण करनेवाली मृत्यु और उत्पन्न होनेवालोंका उभ्दव मैं हूँ तथा स्त्री-जातिमें कीर्ति, श्री, वाक्, स्मृति, मेधा, धृति और क्षमा मैं हूँ।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।10.34।। मैं सर्वभक्षक मृत्यु और भविष्य में होने वालों की उत्पत्ति का कारण हूँ; स्त्रियों में कीर्ति, श्री, वाक (वाणी), स्मृति, मेधा, धृति और क्षमा हूँ।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: I am also death, which snatches away all. I am the origin of all that will be born. Among women, I am fame, prosperity, speech, memory, intelligence, endurance, and forgiveness.

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: And I am Death, the destroyer of all; and the bestower of prosperity to those destined to be prosperous. Of the feminine [Narinam may mean 'of the feminine qualities'. According to Sridhara Swami and S., the words fame etc. signify the goddesses of the respective qualities. According to M.S. these seven goddesses are the wives of the god Dharma.-Tr.] (I am) fame, beauty, speech, memory, intelligence, fortitude, and forbearance.

verses.editorialSummary: I am also death, which snatches away all.
verses.commentary: 10.34 मृत्युः death? सर्वहरः alldevouring? च and? अहम् I? उद्भवः the prosperity? च and? भविष्यताम् of those who are to be prosperous? कीर्तिः frame? श्रीः prosperity? वाक् speech? च and? नारीणाम् of the feminine? स्मृतिः the memory? मेधा intelligence? धृतिः firmness? क्षमा forgiveness.Commentary I am also the allsnatching death that destroys everything. Death is of two kinds? viz.? he who seizes wealth and he who…

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text: ।।10.34।। व्याख्या--'मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहम्'--मृत्युमें हरण करनेकी ऐसी विलक्षण सामर्थ्य है कि मृत्युके बाद यहाँकी स्मृतितक नहीं रहती, सब कुछ अपहृत हो जाता है। वास्तवमें यह सामर्थ्य मृत्युकी नहीं है, प्रत्युत परमात्माकी है।अगर सम्पूर्णका हरण करनेकी, विस्मृत करनेकी भगवत्प्रदत्त सामर्थ्य मृत्युमें न होती तो अपनेपनके सम्बन्धको लेकर जैसी चिन्ता इस जन्ममें मनुष्यको होती है, वैसी ही चिन्ता पिछले जन्मके सम्बन्धको लेकर भी होती। मनुष्य न जाने कितने जन्म ले चुका है। अगर उन जन्मोंकी याद रहती तो मनुष्यकी चिन्ताओंका, उसके मोहका कभी अन्त आता ही नहीं। परन्तु मृत्युके द्वारा विस्मृति होनेसे पूर्वजन्मोंके कुटुम्ब, सम्पत्ति आदिकी चिन्ता नहीं होती। इस तरह मृत्युमें जो चिन्ता, मोह मिटानेकी सामर्थ्य है, वह सब भगवान्की है।

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 10.34 मृत्युः death? सर्वहरः alldevouring? च and? अहम् I? उद्भवः the prosperity? च and? भविष्यताम् of those who are to be prosperous? कीर्तिः frame? श्रीः prosperity? वाक् speech? च and? नारीणाम् of the feminine? स्मृतिः the memory? मेधा intelligence? धृतिः firmness? क्षमा forgiveness.Commentary I am also the allsnatching death that destroys everything. Death is of two kinds? viz.? he who seizes wealth and he who seizes life. Of them he who seizes life is the allseizer and,hence he is called Sarvaharah. I am he.Or? there is another interpretation. I am the Supreme Lord Who is the allseizer? because I destroy everything at the time of the cosmic dissolution.I am the origin of all the beings to be born in the future. I am the prosperity and the means of achieving it of those who are fit to attain it.Beauty is Sri. Lustre is Sri. I am fame? the best of the feminine alities. People who have…

verses.title: Verse 407
verses.sanskrit:
बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम्।

मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः।।10.35।।
verses.transliteration:
bṛihat-sāma tathā sāmnāṁ gāyatrī chhandasām aham
māsānāṁ mārga-śhīrṣho ’ham ṛitūnāṁ kusumākaraḥ
verses.wordMeanings: bṛihat-sāma—the Brihatsama; tathā—also; sāmnām—amongst the hymns in the Sama Veda; gāyatrī—the Gayatri mantra; chhandasām—amongst poetic meters; aham—I; māsānām—of the twelve months; mārga-śhīrṣhaḥ—the month of November-December; aham—I; ṛitūnām—of all seasons; kusuma-ākaraḥ—spring

translations.hindi: ।।10.35।। सामों (गेय मन्त्रों) में मैं बृहत्साम और छन्दों में गायत्री छन्द हूँ; मैं मासों में मार्गशीर्ष (दिसम्बरजनवरी के भाग) और ऋतुओं में वसन्त हूँ।।
translations.english: Of Saman hymns, I am the Brhatsaman; of meters, I am the Gayatri; of months, I am Margasira (Nov-Dec); and of seasons, I am the season of flowers.

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।10.35।। गायी जानेवाली श्रुतियोंमें बृहत्साम और वैदिक छन्दोंमें गायत्री छन्द मैं हूँ। बारह महीनोंमें मार्गशीर्ष और छः ऋतुओंमें वसन्त मैं हूँ।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।10.35।। सामों (गेय मन्त्रों) में मैं बृहत्साम और छन्दों में गायत्री छन्द हूँ; मैं मासों में मार्गशीर्ष (दिसम्बरजनवरी के भाग) और ऋतुओं में वसन्त हूँ।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: Of Saman hymns, I am the Brhatsaman; of meters, I am the Gayatri; of months, I am Margasira (Nov-Dec); and of seasons, I am the season of flowers.

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: I am also the Brhat-sama of the Sama-mantras; of the meters, Gayatri. Of the months, I am Marga-sirsa, and of the seasons, spring.

verses.editorialSummary: Of Saman hymns, I am the Brhatsaman; of meters, I am the Gayatri; of months, I am Margasira (Nov-Dec); and of seasons, I am the season of flowers.
verses.commentary: 10.35 बृहत्साम Brihatsaman? तथा also? साम्नाम् among Sama hymns? गायत्री Gayatri? छन्दसाम् among metres? अहम् I? मासानाम् among months? मार्गशीर्षः Margasirsha? अहम् I? ऋतूनाम् among seasons? कुसुमाकरः the flowery season (spring).Commentary Brihatsaman is the chief of the hymns of the SamaVeda. Brihat means big.Margasirsha From the middle of December to the middle of January. This has a temperate climate. In olden…

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text: ।।10.35।। व्याख्या--'बृहत्साम तथा साम्नाम्'--सामवेदमें बृहत्साम नामक एक गीति है। इसके द्वारा इन्द्ररूप परमेश्वरकी स्तुति की गयी है। अतिरात्रयागमें यह एक पृष्ठस्तोत्र है। सामवेदमें सबसे श्रेष्ठ होनेसे इस बृहत्सामको भगवान्ने अपनी विभूति बताया है (टिप्पणी प0 564)।

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 10.35 बृहत्साम Brihatsaman? तथा also? साम्नाम् among Sama hymns? गायत्री Gayatri? छन्दसाम् among metres? अहम् I? मासानाम् among months? मार्गशीर्षः Margasirsha? अहम् I? ऋतूनाम् among seasons? कुसुमाकरः the flowery season (spring).Commentary Brihatsaman is the chief of the hymns of the SamaVeda. Brihat means big.Margasirsha From the middle of December to the middle of January. This has a temperate climate. In olden days it was usual to start with this month in counting the months of the year. The first place was given to this month.Kusumakara The beautiful flowery season? the spring.

verses.title: Verse 408
verses.sanskrit:
द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्।

जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम्।।10.36।।
verses.transliteration:
dyūtaṁ chhalayatām asmi tejas tejasvinām aham
jayo ’smi vyavasāyo ’smi sattvaṁ sattvavatām aham
verses.wordMeanings: dyūtam—gambling; chhalayatām—of all cheats; asmi—I am; tejaḥ—the splendor; tejasvinām—of the splendid; aham—I; jayaḥ—victory; asmi—I am; vyavasāyaḥ—firm resolve; asmi—I am; sattvam—virtue; sattva-vatām—of the virtuous; aham—I

translations.hindi: ।।10.36।। मैं छल करने वालों में द्यूत हूँ और तेजस्वियों में तेज हूँ, मैं विजय हूँ; मैं व्यवसाय (उद्यमशीलता) हूँ और सात्विक पुरुषों का सात्विक भाव हूँ।।
translations.english: Of the fraudulent, I am gambling; I am the brilliance of the brilliant; I am victory, I am effort; I am the magnanimity of the magnanimous.

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।10.36।। छल करनेवालोंमें जूआ और तेजस्वियोंमें तेज मैं हूँ। जीतनेवालोंकी विजय, निश्चय करनेवालोंका निश्चय और सात्त्विक मनुष्योंका सात्त्विक भाव मैं हूँ।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।10.36।। मैं छल करने वालों में द्यूत हूँ और तेजस्वियों में तेज हूँ, मैं विजय हूँ; मैं व्यवसाय (उद्यमशीलता) हूँ और सात्विक पुरुषों का सात्विक भाव हूँ।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: Of the fraudulent, I am gambling; I am the brilliance of the brilliant; I am victory, I am effort; I am the magnanimity of the magnanimous.

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: Of the fraudulent, I am the gambling; I am the irresistible end of the mighty. I am excellence, I am effort, I am the sattva quality of those possessed of sattva.

verses.editorialSummary: Of the fraudulent, I am gambling; I am the brilliance of the brilliant; I am victory, I am effort; I am the magnanimity of the magnanimous.
verses.commentary: 10.36 द्यूतम् the gambling? छलयताम् of the fraudulent? अस्मि (I) am? तेजः splendour? तेजस्विनाम् of the splendid? अहम् I? जयः victory? अस्मि (I) am? व्यवसायः determination? अस्मि (I) am? सत्त्वम् the goodness? सत्त्ववताम् of the good? अहम् I.Commentary Of the methods of defrauding others I am gambling such as diceplay. Gambling is My manifestation. I am the power of the powerful. I am the victoyr of the victorious.…

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text:
।।10.36।। व्याख्या--'द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि'--छल करके दूसरोंके राज्य, वैभव, धन, सम्पत्ति आदिका (सर्वस्वका) अपहरण करनेकी विशेष सामर्थ्य रखनेवाली जो विद्या है, उसको जूआ कहते हैं। इस जूएको भगवान्ने अपनी विभूति बताया है।

 शङ्का--यहाँ भगवान्ने छल करनेवालोंमें जूएको अपनी विभूति बताया है तो फिर इसके खेलनमें क्या दोष है? अगर दोष नहीं है तो फिर शास्त्रोंने इसका निषेध क्यों किया है।

 समाधान --'ऐसा करो और ऐसा मत करो'-- यह शास्त्रोंका विधि-निषेध कहलाता है। ऐसे विधि-निषेधका वर्णन यहाँ नहीं है। यहाँ तो विभूतियोंका वर्णन है। मैं आपका चिन्तन कहाँ-कहाँ करूँ?' -- अर्जुनके इस प्रश्नके अनुसार भगवान्ने विभूतियोंके रूपमें अपने चिन्तनकी बात ही बतायी है अर्थात् भगवान्का चिन्तन सुगमतासे हो जाय, इसका उपाय विभूतियोंके रूपमें बताया है। अतः जिस समुदायमें मनुष्य रहता है, उस समुदायमें जहाँ दृष्टि पड़े, वहाँ संसारको न देखकर भगवान्को ही देखे; क्योंकि भगवान् कहते हैं कि यह सम्पूर्ण जगत् मेरेसे व्याप्त है अर्थात् इस जगत्में…

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 10.36 द्यूतम् the gambling? छलयताम् of the fraudulent? अस्मि (I) am? तेजः splendour? तेजस्विनाम् of the splendid? अहम् I? जयः victory? अस्मि (I) am? व्यवसायः determination? अस्मि (I) am? सत्त्वम् the goodness? सत्त्ववताम् of the good? अहम् I.Commentary Of the methods of defrauding others I am gambling such as diceplay. Gambling is My manifestation. I am the power of the powerful. I am the victoyr of the victorious. I am the effort of those who make that effort.I am Sattva which assumes the forms of Dharma (virtue)? Jnana (knowledge)? Vairagya (dispassion)? and Aisvarya (wealth or lordship) in Sattvic persons.

verses.title: Verse 409
verses.sanskrit:
वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनंजयः।

मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः।।10.37।।
verses.transliteration:
vṛiṣhṇīnāṁ vāsudevo ’smi pāṇḍavānāṁ dhanañjayaḥ
munīnām apyahaṁ vyāsaḥ kavīnām uśhanā kaviḥ
verses.wordMeanings: vṛiṣhṇīnām—amongst the descendants of Vrishni; vāsudevaḥ—Krishna, the son of Vasudev; asmi—I am; pāṇḍavānām—amongst the Pandavas; dhanañjayaḥ—Arjun, the conqueror of wealth; munīnām—amongst the sages; api—also; aham—I; vyāsaḥ—Ved Vyas; kavīnām—amongst the great thinkers; uśhanā—Shukracharya; kaviḥ—the thinker

translations.hindi: ।।10.37।। मैं वृष्णियों में वासुदेव हूँ और पाण्डवों में धनंजय, मैं मुनियों में व्यास और कवियों में उशना कवि हूँ।।
translations.english: Of the Vrsnis, I am Vasudeva; of the Pandavas, I am Arjuna; of sages, I am Vyasa; and of seers, I am Usana (Sukra).

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।10.37।। वृष्णिवंशियोंमें वासुदेव और पाण्डवोंमें धनञ्जय मैं हूँ। मुनियोंमें वेदव्यास और कवियोंमें कवि शुक्राचार्य भी मैं हूँ।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।10.37।। मैं वृष्णियों में वासुदेव हूँ और पाण्डवों में धनंजय, मैं मुनियों में व्यास और कवियों में उशना कवि हूँ।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: Of the Vrsnis, I am Vasudeva; of the Pandavas, I am Arjuna; of sages, I am Vyasa; and of seers, I am Usana (Sukra).

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: Of the Vrsnis, I am Vasudeva; of the Pandavas, Dhananjaya (Arjuna). Of the wise, I am Vyasa; of the omniscient, the omniscient Usanas.

verses.editorialSummary: Of the Vrsnis, I am Vasudeva; of the Pandavas, I am Arjuna; of sages, I am Vyasa; and of seers, I am Usana (Sukra).
verses.commentary: 10.37 वृष्णीनाम among the Vrishnis? वासुदेवः Vaasudeva? अस्मि (I) am? पाण्डवानाम् among the Pandavas? धनञ्जयः Dhananjaya? मुनीनाम् among the sages? अपि also? अहम् I? व्यासः Vyasa? कवीनाम् among poets? उशनाः Usanas? कविः the poet.Commentary Vrishnis are Yadavas or the descendants of Yadu. I am the foremost among them.Usanas is Sukracharya? the preceptor of the demons.

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text: ।।10.37।। व्याख्या--'वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि--यहाँ भगवान् श्रीकृष्णके अवतारका वर्णन नहीं है, प्रत्युत वृष्णिवंशियोंमें अपनी जो विशेषता है, उस विशेषताको लेकर भगवान्ने अपना विभूतिरूपसे वर्णन किया है।यहाँ भगवान्का अपनेको विभूतिरूपसे कहना तो' संसारकी दृष्टिसे है, स्वरूपकी दृष्टिसे तो वे साक्षात् भगवान् ही हैं। इस अध्यायमें जितनी विभूतियाँ आयी हैं, वे सब संसारकी दृष्टिसे ही हैं। तत्त्वतः तो वे,परमात्मस्वरूप ही हैं।

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 10.37 वृष्णीनाम among the Vrishnis? वासुदेवः Vaasudeva? अस्मि (I) am? पाण्डवानाम् among the Pandavas? धनञ्जयः Dhananjaya? मुनीनाम् among the sages? अपि also? अहम् I? व्यासः Vyasa? कवीनाम् among poets? उशनाः Usanas? कविः the poet.Commentary Vrishnis are Yadavas or the descendants of Yadu. I am the foremost among them.Usanas is Sukracharya? the preceptor of the demons.

verses.title: Verse 410
verses.sanskrit:
दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम्।

मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम्।।10.38।।
verses.transliteration:
daṇḍo damayatām asmi nītir asmi jigīṣhatām
maunaṁ chaivāsmi guhyānāṁ jñānaṁ jñānavatām aham
verses.wordMeanings: daṇḍaḥ—punishment; damayatām—amongst means of preventing lawlessness; asmi—I am; nītiḥ—proper conduct; asmi—I am; jigīṣhatām—amongst those who seek victory; maunam—silence; cha—and; eva—also; asmi—I am; guhyānām—amongst secrets; jñānam—wisdom; jñāna-vatām—in the wise; aham—I

translations.hindi: ।।10.38।। मैं दमन करने वालों का दण्ड हूँ और विजयेच्छुओं की नीति हूँ; मैं गुह्यों में मौन हूँ और ज्ञानवानों का ज्ञान हूँ।।
translations.english: Of those who punish, I am the principle of punishment. Of those who seek victory, I am policy. Of secrets, I am also silence. And of the wise, I am wisdom.

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।10.38।। दमन करनेवालोंमें दण्डनीति और विजय चाहनेवालोंमें नीति मैं हूँ। गोपनीय भावोंमें मौन और ज्ञानवानोंमें ज्ञान मैं हूँ।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।10.38।। मैं दमन करने वालों का दण्ड हूँ और विजयेच्छुओं की नीति हूँ; मैं गुह्यों में मौन हूँ और ज्ञानवानों का ज्ञान हूँ।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: Of those who punish, I am the principle of punishment. Of those who seek victory, I am policy. Of secrets, I am also silence. And of the wise, I am wisdom.

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: Of the punishers, I am the rod; I am the righteous policy of those who desire to conquer. And of things secret, I am verily silence; I am the knowledge of the wise.

verses.editorialSummary: Of those who punish, I am the principle of punishment.
verses.commentary: 10.38 दण्डः the sceptre? दमयताम् among punishers? अस्मि (I) am? नीतिः statesmanship? अस्मि (I) am? जिगीषताम् among thoese who seek victory? मौनम् silence? च and? एव also? अस्मि (I) am? गुह्यानाम् among secrets? ज्ञानम् the knowledge? ज्ञानवताम् among the knowers? अहम् I.Commentary Niti Diplomacy? polity.Maunam The silence produced by constant meditation on Brahman or the Self.Jnanam Knowledge of the Self.

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text: ।।10.38।। व्याख्या--'दण्डो दमयतामस्मि'--दुष्टोंको दुष्टतासे बचाकर सन्मार्गपर लानेके लिये दण्डनीति मुख्य है। इसलिये भगवान्ने इसको अपनी विभूति बताया है।

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 10.38 दण्डः the sceptre? दमयताम् among punishers? अस्मि (I) am? नीतिः statesmanship? अस्मि (I) am? जिगीषताम् among thoese who seek victory? मौनम् silence? च and? एव also? अस्मि (I) am? गुह्यानाम् among secrets? ज्ञानम् the knowledge? ज्ञानवताम् among the knowers? अहम् I.Commentary Niti Diplomacy? polity.Maunam The silence produced by constant meditation on Brahman or the Self.Jnanam Knowledge of the Self.

verses.title: Verse 411
verses.sanskrit:
यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन।

न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम्।।10.39।।
verses.transliteration:
yach chāpi sarva-bhūtānāṁ bījaṁ tad aham arjuna
na tad asti vinā yat syān mayā bhūtaṁ charācharam
verses.wordMeanings: yat—which; cha—and; api—also; sarva-bhūtānām—of all living beings; bījam—generating seed; tat—that; aham—I; arjuna—Arjun; na—not; tat—that; asti—is; vinā—without; yat—which; syāt—may exist; mayā—me; bhūtam—creature; chara-acharam—moving and nonmoving

translations.hindi: ।।10.39।। हे अर्जुन ! जो समस्त भूतों की उत्पत्ति का बीज (कारण) है, वह भी में ही हूँ, क्योंकि ऐसा कोई चर और अचर भूत नहीं है, जो मुझसे रहित है।।
translations.english: I am also that which is the seed of all beings, O Arjuna. Nothing that moves or does not move exists without Me.

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।10.39।। हे अर्जुन! सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंका जो बीज है, वह बीज मैं ही हूँ; क्योंकि मेरे बिना कोई भी चर-अचर प्राणी नहीं है अर्थात् चर-अचर सब कुछ मैं ही हूँ।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।10.39।। हे अर्जुन ! जो समस्त भूतों की उत्पत्ति का बीज (कारण) है, वह भी में ही हूँ, क्योंकि ऐसा कोई चर और अचर भूत नहीं है, जो मुझसे रहित है।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: I am also that which is the seed of all beings, O Arjuna. Nothing that moves or does not move exists without Me.

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: Moreover, O Arjuna, I am the seed of all beings. There is nothing, moving or non-moving, that can exist without Me.

verses.editorialSummary: I am also that which is the seed of all beings, O Arjuna.
verses.commentary: 10.39 यत् which? च and? अपि also? सर्वभूतानाम् among all beings? बीजम् seed? तत् that? अहम् I? अर्जुन O Arjuna? न not? तत् that? अस्ति is? विना without? यत् which? स्यात् may be? मया by Me? भूतम् being? चराचरम् moving or unmoving.Commentary I am the primeval seed from which all creation has come into existence. I am the seed of everything. I am the Self of everything. Nothing can exist without Me. Everything is of…

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text: ।।10.39।। व्याख्या--'यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदमहर्जुन'--यहाँ भगवान् समस्त विभूतियोंका सार बताते हैं कि सबका बीज अर्थात् कारण मैं ही हूँ। बीज कहनेका तात्पर्य है कि इस संसारका निमित्त कारण भी मैं हूँ और उपादान कारण भी मैं हूँ अर्थात् संसारको बनानेवाला भी मैं हूँ और संसाररूपसे बननेवाला भी मैं हूँ।भगवान्ने सातवें अध्यायके दसवें श्लोकमें अपनेको 'सनातन बीज', नवें अध्यायके अठारहवें श्लोकमें 'अव्यय बीज' और यहाँ केवल 'बीज' बताया है। इसका तात्पर्य है कि मैं ज्योंकात्यों रहता हुआ ही संसाररूपसे प्रकट हो जाता हूँ और संसाररूपसे प्रकट होनेपर भी मैं उसमें ज्यों-का-त्यों व्यापक रहता हूँ।

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 10.39 यत् which? च and? अपि also? सर्वभूतानाम् among all beings? बीजम् seed? तत् that? अहम् I? अर्जुन O Arjuna? न not? तत् that? अस्ति is? विना without? यत् which? स्यात् may be? मया by Me? भूतम् being? चराचरम् moving or unmoving.Commentary I am the primeval seed from which all creation has come into existence. I am the seed of everything. I am the Self of everything. Nothing can exist without Me. Everything is of My nature. I am the essence of everything. Without Me all things would be mere void. I am the soul of everything.

verses.title: Verse 412
verses.sanskrit:
नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परंतप।

एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया।।10.40।।
verses.transliteration:
nānto ’sti mama divyānāṁ vibhūtīnāṁ parantapa
eṣha tūddeśhataḥ prokto vibhūter vistaro mayā
verses.wordMeanings: na—not; antaḥ—end; asti—is; mama—my; divyānām—divine; vibhūtīnām—manifestations; parantapa—Arjun, the conqueror of the enemies; eṣhaḥ—this; tu—but; uddeśhataḥ—just one portion; proktaḥ—declared; vibhūteḥ—of (my) glories; vistaraḥ—the breath of the topic; mayā—by me

translations.hindi: ।।10.40।। हे परन्तप ! मेरी दिव्य विभूतियों का अन्त नहीं है; अपनी विभूतियों का यह विस्तार मैंने एक देश से अर्थात् संक्षेप में कहा है।।
translations.english: There is no limit to My divine manifestations. Here, I have briefly described the extent of such manifestations.

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।10.40।। हे परंतप अर्जुन ! मेरी दिव्य विभूतियोंका अन्त नहीं है। मैंने तुम्हारे सामने अपनी विभूतियोंका जो विस्तार कहा है, यह तो केवल संक्षेपसे कहा है।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।10.40।। हे परन्तप ! मेरी दिव्य विभूतियों का अन्त नहीं है; अपनी विभूतियों का यह विस्तार मैंने एक देश से अर्थात् संक्षेप में कहा है।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: There is no limit to My divine manifestations. Here, I have briefly described the extent of such manifestations.

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: O destroyer of enemies, there is no limit to My divine manifestations. This description of My manifestations, however, has been stated by Me as an illustration.

verses.editorialSummary: There is no limit to My divine manifestations.
verses.commentary: 10.40 न not? अन्तः end? अस्ति is? मम My? दिव्यानाम् of divine? विभूतीनाम् glories? परंतप O scorcher of foes? एषः this? तु indeed? उद्देशतः briefly? प्रोक्तः has been stated? विभूतेः of glory? विस्तरः particulars? मया by Me.Commentary It is impossible for anyone to describe or know the exact extent of the divine gloreis of the Lord. There is no limit to His powers or glories. What could be expressed of Him is nothing…

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text: ।।10.40।। व्याख्या--'मम दिव्यानां (टिप्पणी प0 568.2) विभूतीनाम्'--'दिव्य' शब्द अलौकिकता, विलक्षणताका द्योतक है। साधकका मन जहाँ चला जाय, वहीं भगवान्का चिन्तन करनेसे यह दिव्यता वहीं प्रकट हो जायगी; क्योंकि भगवान्के समान दिव्य कोई है ही नहीं। देवता जो दिव्य कहे जाते हैं, वे भी नित्य ही भगवान्के दर्शनकी इच्छा रखते हैं, --

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 10.40 न not? अन्तः end? अस्ति is? मम My? दिव्यानाम् of divine? विभूतीनाम् glories? परंतप O scorcher of foes? एषः this? तु indeed? उद्देशतः briefly? प्रोक्तः has been stated? विभूतेः of glory? विस्तरः particulars? मया by Me.Commentary It is impossible for anyone to describe or know the exact extent of the divine gloreis of the Lord. There is no limit to His powers or glories. What could be expressed of Him is nothing when compared to His infinte glories.Parantapa Scorcher of foes -- he who burns the internal enemies? lust? anger? greed? deluion? etc.

verses.title: Verse 413
verses.sanskrit:
यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा।

तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसंभवम्।।10.41।।
verses.transliteration:
yad yad vibhūtimat sattvaṁ śhrīmad ūrjitam eva vā
tat tad evāvagachchha tvaṁ mama tejo ’nśha-sambhavam
verses.wordMeanings: yat yat—whatever; vibhūtimat—opulent; sattvam—being; śhrī-mat—beautiful; ūrjitam—glorious; eva—also; vā—or; tat tat—all that; eva—only; avagachchha—know; tvam—you; mama—my; tejaḥ-anśha-sambhavam—splendor; anśha—a part; sambhavam—born of

translations.hindi: ।।10.41।। जो कोई भी विभूतियुक्त, कान्तियुक्त अथवा शक्तियुक्त वस्तु (या प्राणी) है, उसको तुम मेरे तेज के अंश से ही उत्पन्न हुई जानो।।
translations.english: Whatever being is possessed of power, or splendour, or energy, know that as coming from a fragment of My power.

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।10.41।। जो-जो ऐश्वर्ययुक्त, शोभायुक्त और बलयुक्त प्राणी तथा वस्तु है, उस-उसको तुम मेरे ही तेज-(योग-) के अंशसे उत्पन्न हुई समझो।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।10.41।। जो कोई भी विभूतियुक्त, कान्तियुक्त अथवा शक्तियुक्त वस्तु (या प्राणी) है, उसको तुम मेरे तेज के अंश से ही उत्पन्न हुई जानो।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: Whatever being is possessed of power, or splendour, or energy, know that as coming from a fragment of My power.

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: Whatever object [all living beings] is verily endowed with majesty, possessed of prosperity, or is energetic, you know for certain each of them as having a part of My power as its source.

verses.editorialSummary: Whatever being is possessed of power, or splendour, or energy, know that as coming from a fragment of My power.
verses.commentary: 10.41 यत् यत् whatever? विभूतिमत् glorious? सत्त्वम् being? श्रीमत् prosperous? ऊर्जितम् powerful? एव also? वा or? तत् तत् that? एव only? अवगच्छ know? त्वम् thou? मम My? तेजोंऽशसंभवम् a manifestation of a part of My splendour.No Commentary.

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text: ।।10.41।। व्याख्या--'यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा'--संसारमात्रमें जिस-किसी सजी-वनिर्जीव वस्तु, व्यक्ति, घटना, परिस्थिति, गुण, भाव, क्रिया आदिमें जो कुछ ऐश्वर्य दीखे, शोभा या सौन्दर्य दीखे, बलवत्ता दीखे, तथा जो कुछ भी विशेषता, विलक्षणता, योग्यता दीखे, उन सबको मेरे तेजके किसी एक अंशसे उत्पन्न हुई जानो। तात्पर्य है कि उनमें वह विलक्षणता मेरे योगसे, सामर्थ्यसे, प्रभावसे ही आयी है -- ऐसा तुम समझो -- 'तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसम्भवम्'। मेरे बिना कहीं भी और कुछ भी विलक्षणता नहीं है।

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 10.41 यत् यत् whatever? विभूतिमत् glorious? सत्त्वम् being? श्रीमत् prosperous? ऊर्जितम् powerful? एव also? वा or? तत् तत् that? एव only? अवगच्छ know? त्वम् thou? मम My? तेजोंऽशसंभवम् a manifestation of a part of My splendour.No Commentary.

verses.title: Verse 414
verses.sanskrit:
अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन।

विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत्।।10.42।।
verses.transliteration:
atha vā bahunaitena kiṁ jñātena tavārjuna
viṣhṭabhyāham idaṁ kṛitsnam ekānśhena sthito jagat
verses.wordMeanings: athavā—or; bahunā—detailed; etena—by this; kim—what; jñātena tava—can be known by you; arjuna—Arjun; viṣhṭabhya—pervade and support; aham—I; idam—this; kṛitsnam—entire; eka—by one; anśhena—fraction; sthitaḥ—am situated; jagat—creation

translations.hindi: ।।10.42।। अथवा हे अर्जुन ! बहुत जानने से तुम्हारा क्या प्रयोजन है? मैं इस सम्पूर्ण जगत् को अपने एक अंश मात्र से धारण करके स्थित हूँ।।
translations.english: But of what use is all this extensive knowledge to you, O Arjuna? I sustain this whole universe with only a fragment of My power.

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।10.42।। अथवा हे अर्जुन ! तुम्हें इस प्रकार बहुत-सी बातें जाननेकी क्या आवश्यकता है? मैं अपने किसी एक अंशसे सम्पूर्ण जगत् को व्याप्त करके स्थित हूँ।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।10.42।। अथवा हे अर्जुन ! बहुत जानने से तुम्हारा क्या प्रयोजन है? मैं इस सम्पूर्ण जगत् को अपने एक अंश मात्र से धारण करके स्थित हूँ।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: But of what use is all this extensive knowledge to you, O Arjuna? I sustain this whole universe with only a fragment of My power.

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: Or, on the other hand, what is the need for you to know this extensively, O Arjuna? I remain sustaining this whole creation in a special way with a part of Myself.

verses.editorialSummary: But of what use is all this extensive knowledge to you, O Arjuna?
verses.commentary: 10.42 अथवा or? बहुना (by) many? एतेन (by) this? किम् what? ज्ञातेन known? तव to thee? अर्जुन O Arjuna? विष्टभ्य supporting? अहम् I? इदम् this? कृत्स्नम् all? एकांशेन by one part? स्थितः exist? जगत् the world.Commentary The Lord concludes Having established or pervaded this whole world with one fragment of Myself? I remain.This verse is based on the declaration in the Purusha Sukta (RigVeda10.90.3) that One arter of…

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text: ।।10.42।। व्याख्या --'अथवा'--यह अव्यय-पद देकर भगवान् अर्जुनसे मानो यह कह रहे हैं कि तुमने जो प्रश्न किया था, उसके अनुसार मैंने उत्तर दिया ही है; अब मैं अपनी तरफसे तेरे लिये एक विशेष महत्त्वकी सार बात बताता हूँ।

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 10.42 अथवा or? बहुना (by) many? एतेन (by) this? किम् what? ज्ञातेन known? तव to thee? अर्जुन O Arjuna? विष्टभ्य supporting? अहम् I? इदम् this? कृत्स्नम् all? एकांशेन by one part? स्थितः exist? जगत् the world.Commentary The Lord concludes Having established or pervaded this whole world with one fragment of Myself? I remain.This verse is based on the declaration in the Purusha Sukta (RigVeda10.90.3) that One arter of Him is all the cosmos the three arters are the divine transcendent Reality.I exist supporting this whole world by one part? by one limit? or by one foot. One part of Myself constitutes all beings.All beings form His foot (Taittiriya Aranyaka 3.12). The whole world is one Pada or foot of the Lord. Amsa (part) or Pada (foot) is mere Kalpana or imagination or account of our own ignorance,or limiting adjunct. In reality Brahman is without any such parts or limbs and is…

verses.title: Verse 415
verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच

मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम्।

यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम।।11.1।।
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvācha
mad-anugrahāya paramaṁ guhyam adhyātma-sanjñitam
yat tvayoktaṁ vachas tena moho ’yaṁ vigato mama
verses.wordMeanings: arjunaḥ uvācha—Arjun said; mat-anugrahāya—out of compassion to me; paramam—supreme; guhyam—confidential; adhyātma-sanjñitam—about spiritual knowledge; yat—which; tvayā—by you; uktam—spoken; vachaḥ—words; tena—by that; mohaḥ—illusion; ayam—this; vigataḥ—is dispelled; mama—my

translations.hindi: ।।11.1।। अर्जुन ने कहा -- मुझ पर अनुग्रह करने के लिए जो परम गोपनीय, अध्यात्मविषयक वचन (उपदेश) आपके द्वारा कहा गया, उससे मेरा मोह दूर हो गया है।।
translations.english: Arjuna said, "To show favor to me, You have told me that most profound mystery concerning the Self; by that, this delusion of mine has been dispelled."

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।11.1।। अर्जुन बोले -- केवल मेरेपर कृपा करनेके लिये ही आपने जो परम गोपनीय अध्यात्मतत्तव जाननेका वचन कहा, उससे मेरा यह मोह नष्ट हो गया है।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।11.1।। अर्जुन ने कहा -- मुझ पर अनुग्रह करने के लिए जो परम गोपनीय, अध्यात्मविषयक वचन (उपदेश) आपके द्वारा कहा गया, उससे मेरा मोह दूर हो गया है।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: Arjuna said, "To show favor to me, You have told me that most profound mystery concerning the Self; by that, this delusion of mine has been dispelled."

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: Arjuna said, "This delusion of mine has departed as a result of that speech which is most secret and pertains to the Self, uttered by You for my benefit."

verses.editorialSummary: Arjuna said, "To show favor to me, You have told me that most profound mystery concerning the Self; by that, this delusion of mine has been dispelled."
verses.commentary: 11.1 मदनुग्रहाय for the sake of blessing me? परमम् the highest? गुह्यम् the secret? अध्यात्मसंज्ञितम् called Adhyatma? यत् which? त्वया by Thee? उक्तम् spoken? वचः word? तेन by that? मोहः delusion? अयम् this? विगतः gone? मम my.Commentary After hearing the glories of the Lord? Arjuna has an intense longing to have the wonderful vision of the Cosmic Form with his own eyes. His bewilderment and delusion have now…

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text: ।।11.1।। व्याख्या--'मदनुग्रहाय'--मेरा भजन करनेवालोंपर कृपा करके मैं स्वयं उनके अज्ञानजन्य अन्धकारका नाश कर देता हूँ (गीता 10। 11) -- यह बात भगवान्ने केवल कृपा-परवश होकर कही। इस बातका अर्जुनपर बड़ा प्रभाव प़ड़ा, जिससे अर्जुन भगवान्की स्तुति करने लगे (10। 12 -- 15)। ऐसी स्तुति उन्होंने पहले गीतामें कहीं नहीं की। उसीका लक्ष्य करके अर्जुन यहाँ कहते हैं कि केवल मेरेपर कृपा करनेके लिये ही आपने ऐसी बात कही है (टिप्पणी प0 573.2)।

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 11.1 मदनुग्रहाय for the sake of blessing me? परमम् the highest? गुह्यम् the secret? अध्यात्मसंज्ञितम् called Adhyatma? यत् which? त्वया by Thee? उक्तम् spoken? वचः word? तेन by that? मोहः delusion? अयम् this? विगतः gone? मम my.Commentary After hearing the glories of the Lord? Arjuna has an intense longing to have the wonderful vision of the Cosmic Form with his own eyes. His bewilderment and delusion have now vanished.Adhyatma That which treats of the discrimination between the Self and the notSelf metaphysics.I was worried about the sin involved in killing my relations and preceptors. I had the ideas? I am the agent in killing them they are to be killed by me.This delusion has vanished now after receiving Thy most profound and valuable instructions. Thou hast dispelled this delusion of ignorance from me.The vision of the Cosmic Form is not the ultimate goal. If that were so? the Gita…

verses.title: Verse 416
verses.sanskrit:
भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया।

त्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष माहात्म्यमपि चाव्ययम्।।11.2।।
verses.transliteration:
bhavāpyayau hi bhūtānāṁ śhrutau vistaraśho mayā
tvattaḥ kamala-patrākṣha māhātmyam api chāvyayam
verses.wordMeanings: bhava—appearance; apyayau—disappearance; hi—indeed; bhūtānām—of all living beings; śhrutau—have heard; vistaraśhaḥ—in detail; mayā—by me; tvattaḥ—from you; kamala-patra-akṣha—lotus-eyed one; māhātmyam—greatness; api—also; cha—and; avyayam—eternal

translations.hindi: ।।11.2।। हे कमलनयन ! मैंने भूतों की उत्पत्ति और प्रलय आपसे विस्तारपूर्वक सुने हैं तथा आपका अव्यय माहात्म्य (प्रभाव) भी सुना है।।
translations.english: O Krsna, I have heard in detail about the origin and dissolution of all beings, which come from You, as well as Your immutable greatness.

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।11.2।। हे कमलनयन ! सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंकी उत्पत्ति और प्रलय मैंने विस्तारपूर्वक आपसे ही सुना है और आपका अविनाशी माहात्म्य भी सुना है।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।11.2।। हे कमलनयन ! मैंने भूतों की उत्पत्ति और प्रलय आपसे विस्तारपूर्वक सुने हैं तथा आपका अव्यय माहात्म्य (प्रभाव) भी सुना है।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: O Krsna, I have heard in detail about the origin and dissolution of all beings, which come from You, as well as Your immutable greatness.

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: O you with eyes like lotus leaves, I have heard in detail from You the origin and dissolution of beings, as well as Your undecaying glory.

verses.editorialSummary: O Krsna, I have heard in detail about the origin and dissolution of all beings, which come from You, as well as Your immutable greatness.
verses.commentary: 11.2 भवाप्ययौ the origin and the dissolution? हि indeed? भूतानाम् of beings? श्रुतौ hav been heard? विस्तरशः in detail? मया by me? त्वत्तः from Thee? कमलपत्राक्ष O lotuseyed? माहात्म्यम् greatness? अपि also? च and? अव्ययम् inexhaustible.Commentary Kamalapatraksha Lotuseyed or having eyes like lotuspetals. Kamalapatra also means knowledge of the Self. He who can be obtained by knowledge of the Self is Kamalapatraksha.

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text: ।।11.2।। व्याख्या --भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां त्वत्तः श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया -- भगवान्ने पहले कहा था-- मैं सम्पूर्ण जगत्का प्रभव और प्रलय हूँ, मेरे सिवाय अन्य कोई कारण नहीं है (7। 6 7); सात्त्विक, राजस और तामस भाव मेरेसे ही होते हैं (7। 12); प्राणियोंके अलग-अलग अनेक तरहके भाव मेरेसे ही होते हैं (10। 4 5); सम्पूर्ण प्राणी मेरेसे ही होते हैं और मेरेसे ही सब चेष्टा करते हैं (10। 8); प्राणियोंके आदि, मध्य तथा अन्तमें मैं ही हूँ (10। 20); और सम्पूर्ण सृष्टियोंके आदि, मध्य तथा अन्तमें मैं ही हूँ (10। 32)। इसीको लेकर अर्जुन यहाँ कहते हैं कि मैंने आपसे प्राणियोंकी उत्पत्ति और प्रलयका वर्णन विस्तारसे सुना है। इसका तात्पर्य प्राणियोंकी उत्पत्ति और विनाश सुननेसे नहीं है, प्रत्युत इसका तात्पर्य यह सुननेसे है कि सभी प्राणी आपसे ही उत्पन्न होते हैं, आपमें ही रहते हैं और आपमें ही लीन हो जाते हैं अर्थात् सब कुछ आप ही हैं।

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 11.2 भवाप्ययौ the origin and the dissolution? हि indeed? भूतानाम् of beings? श्रुतौ hav been heard? विस्तरशः in detail? मया by me? त्वत्तः from Thee? कमलपत्राक्ष O lotuseyed? माहात्म्यम् greatness? अपि also? च and? अव्ययम् inexhaustible.Commentary Kamalapatraksha Lotuseyed or having eyes like lotuspetals. Kamalapatra also means knowledge of the Self. He who can be obtained by knowledge of the Self is Kamalapatraksha.

verses.title: Verse 417
verses.sanskrit:
एवमेतद्यथात्थ त्वमात्मानं परमेश्वर।

द्रष्टुमिच्छामि ते रूपमैश्वरं पुरुषोत्तम।।11.3।।
verses.transliteration:
evam etad yathāttha tvam ātmānaṁ parameśhvara
draṣhṭum ichchhāmi te rūpam aiśhwaraṁ puruṣhottama
verses.wordMeanings: evam—thus; etat—this; yathā—as; āttha—have spoken; tvam—you; ātmānam—yourself; parama-īśhvara—Supreme Lord; draṣhṭum—to see; ichchhāmi—I desire; te—your; rūpam—form; aiśhwaram—divine; puruṣha-uttama—Shree Krishna, the Supreme Divine Personality

translations.hindi: ।।11.3।। हे परमेश्वर ! आप अपने को जैसा कहते हो, यह ठीक ऐसा ही है। (परन्तु) हे पुरुषोत्तम ! मैं आपके ईश्वरीय रूप को प्रत्यक्ष देखना चाहता हूँ।।
translations.english: O Supreme Lord, as You have described Yourself, so You are. I wish to behold Your divine form, O Supreme Person.

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।11.3।। हे पुरुषोत्तम ! आप अपने-आपको जैसा कहते हैं, यह वास्तवमें ऐसा ही है। हे परमेश्वर ! आपके ईश्वर-सम्बन्धी रूपको मैं देखना चाहता हूँ।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।11.3।। हे परमेश्वर ! आप अपने को जैसा कहते हो, यह ठीक ऐसा ही है। (परन्तु) हे पुरुषोत्तम ! मैं आपके ईश्वरीय रूप को प्रत्यक्ष देखना चाहता हूँ।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: O Supreme Lord, as You have described Yourself, so You are. I wish to behold Your divine form, O Supreme Person.

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: O Supreme Lord, so it is, as You have spoken of Yourself. O Supreme Person, I wish to behold Your divine form.

verses.editorialSummary: O Supreme Lord, as You have described Yourself, so You are.
verses.commentary: 11.3 एवम् thus? एतत् this? यथा as? आत्थ hast declared? त्वम् Thou? आत्मानम् Thyself? परमेश्वर O Supreme Lord? द्रष्टुम् to see? इच्छामि (I) desire? ते Thy? रूपम् form? ऐश्वरम् sovereign? पुरुषोत्तम O Supreme Purusha.Commentary Some commentators take the two halves of this verse as two independent sentences and interpret it thusSo it is? O Supreme Lord? as Thou hast declared Thyself to be. (But still) I desire to see…

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text: ।।11.3।। व्याख्या --'पुरुषोत्तम'--यह सम्बोधन देनेका तात्पर्य है कि हे भगवन् !मेरी दृष्टिमें इस संसारमें आपके समान कोई उत्तम, श्रेष्ठ नहीं है अर्थात् आप ही सबसे उत्तम, श्रेष्ठ हैं। इस बातको आगे पन्द्रहवें अध्यायमें भगवान्ने भी कहा है कि मैं क्षरसे अतीत और अक्षरसे उत्तम हूँ; अतः मैं शास्त्र और वेदमें पुरुषोत्तम नामसे प्रसिद्ध हूँ (15। 18)।

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 11.3 एवम् thus? एतत् this? यथा as? आत्थ hast declared? त्वम् Thou? आत्मानम् Thyself? परमेश्वर O Supreme Lord? द्रष्टुम् to see? इच्छामि (I) desire? ते Thy? रूपम् form? ऐश्वरम् sovereign? पुरुषोत्तम O Supreme Purusha.Commentary Some commentators take the two halves of this verse as two independent sentences and interpret it thusSo it is? O Supreme Lord? as Thou hast declared Thyself to be. (But still) I desire to see Thy form as Isvara? O Supreme Person.Rupamaisvaram Thy form as Isvara? that of Vishnu as possessed of infinite knowledge? sovereignty? power? strength? prowess and splendour.

verses.title: Verse 418
verses.sanskrit:
मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो।

योगेश्वर ततो मे त्वं दर्शयाऽत्मानमव्ययम्।।11.4।।
verses.transliteration:
manyase yadi tach chhakyaṁ mayā draṣhṭum iti prabho
yogeśhvara tato me tvaṁ darśhayātmānam avyayam
verses.wordMeanings: manyase—you think; yadi—if; tat—that; śhakyam—possible; mayā—by me; draṣhṭum—to behold; iti—thus; prabho—Lord; yoga-īśhvara—Lord of all mystic powers; tataḥ—then; me—to me; tvam—you; darśhaya—reveal; ātmānam—yourself; avyayam—imperishable

translations.hindi: ।।11.4।। हे प्रभो ! यदि आप मानते हैं कि मेरे द्वारा वह आपका रूप देखा जाना संभव है, तो हे योगेश्वर ! आप अपने अव्यय रूप का दर्शन कराइये।।
translations.english: If you think, O Lord, that it can be seen by me, then, O Lord of Yoga, reveal Yourself fully to me.

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।11.4।। हे प्रभो ! मेरे द्वारा आपका वह परम ऐश्वर रूप देखा जा सकता है -- ऐसा अगर आप मानते हैं, तो हे योगेश्वर ! आप अपने उस अविनाशी स्वरूपको मुझे दिखा दीजिये।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।11.4।। हे प्रभो ! यदि आप मानते हैं कि मेरे द्वारा वह आपका रूप देखा जाना संभव है, तो हे योगेश्वर ! आप अपने अव्यय रूप का दर्शन कराइये।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: If you think, O Lord, that it can be seen by me, then, O Lord of Yoga, reveal Yourself fully to me.

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: O Lord, if You deem it possible for me to behold You, then, O Lord of Yoga, show me Your eternal Self.

verses.editorialSummary: If you think, O Lord, that it can be seen by me, then, O Lord of Yoga, reveal Yourself fully to me.
verses.commentary: 11.4 मन्यसे Thou thinkest? यदि if? तत् that? शक्यम् possible? मया by me? द्रष्टुम् to see? इति thus? प्रभो O Lord? योगेश्वर O Lord of Yogins? ततः then? मे me? त्वम् Thou? दर्शय show? आत्मानम् (Thy) Self? अव्ययम् imperishable.Commentary Arjuna is very keen and eager to see the Cosmic Form of the Lord. He prays to Him to grant him the vision. This supreme vision can be obtained only through His grace.Yogesvara also…

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text: ।।11.4।। व्याख्या--'प्रभो'-- 'प्रभु' नाम सर्वसमर्थका है, इसलिये इस सम्बोधनका भाव यह मालूम देता है कि यदि आप मेरेमें विराट्रूप देखनेकी सामर्थ्य मानते हैं, तब तो ठीक है; नहीं तो आप मेरेको ऐसी सामर्थ्य दीजिये, जिससे मैं आपका वह ऐश्वर (ईश्वरसम्बन्धी) रूप देख सकूँ।

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 11.4 मन्यसे Thou thinkest? यदि if? तत् that? शक्यम् possible? मया by me? द्रष्टुम् to see? इति thus? प्रभो O Lord? योगेश्वर O Lord of Yogins? ततः then? मे me? त्वम् Thou? दर्शय show? आत्मानम् (Thy) Self? अव्ययम् imperishable.Commentary Arjuna is very keen and eager to see the Cosmic Form of the Lord. He prays to Him to grant him the vision. This supreme vision can be obtained only through His grace.Yogesvara also means the Lord of Yoga. A Yogi is one who is endowed with the eight psychic powers (Siddhis). The Lord of the Yogins is Yogesvara. And? Yoga is identity of the individual soul with the Absolute. He who is able to bestow this realisation of identity on the deserving spiritual aspirant is Yogesvara.He Who is able to create? preserve? destroy? veil and graciously release is the Lord. verses.title: Verse 419
verses.sanskrit:
श्री भगवानुवाच

पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।

नानाविधानि दिव्यानि नानावर्णाकृतीनि च।।11.5।।
verses.transliteration:
śhrī-bhagavān uvācha
paśhya me pārtha rūpāṇi śhataśho ’tha sahasraśhaḥ
nānā-vidhāni divyāni nānā-varṇākṛitīni cha
verses.wordMeanings: śhrī-bhagavān uvācha—the Supreme Lord said; paśhya—behold; me—my; pārtha—Arjun, the son of Pritha; rūpāṇi—forms; śhataśhaḥ—by the hundreds; atha—and; sahasraśhaḥ—thousands; nānā-vidhāni—various; divyāni—divine; nānā—various; varṇa—colors; ākṛitīni—shapes; cha—and

translations.hindi: ।।11.5।। श्रीभगवान् ने कहा -- हे पार्थ ! मेरे सैकड़ों तथा सहस्रों नाना प्रकार के और नाना वर्ण तथा आकृति वाले दिव्य रूपों को देखो।।
translations.english: The Lord said, "Behold, O Arjuna, My forms, hundreds upon thousands, manifold, divine, varied in hue and shape."

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।11.5।। श्रीभगवान् बोले -- हे पृथानन्दन ! अब मेरे अनेक तरहके, अनेक अनेक वर्णों और आकृतियोंवाले सैकड़ों-हजारों दिव्यरूपोंको तू देख।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।11.5।। श्रीभगवान् ने कहा -- हे पार्थ ! मेरे सैकड़ों तथा सहस्रों नाना प्रकार के और नाना वर्ण तथा आकृति वाले दिव्य रूपों को देखो।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: The Lord said, "Behold, O Arjuna, My forms, hundreds upon thousands, manifold, divine, varied in hue and shape."

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: The Blessed Lord said, "O son of Prtha, behold My forms in their hundreds and thousands, of different kinds, celestial, and of various colors and shapes."

verses.editorialSummary: The Lord said, "Behold, O Arjuna, My forms, hundreds upon thousands, manifold, divine, varied in hue and shape."
verses.commentary: 11.5 पश्य behold? मे My? पार्थ O Partha? रूपाणि forms? शतशः by hundreds? अथ and? सहस्रशः by thousands? नानाविधानि of different sorts? दिव्यानि divine? नानावर्णाकृतीनि of various colours and shapes? च and.Commentary Divyani Divine supernatural.Satasah? Sahasrasah By the hundreds and thousands -- countless.O Arjuna? I want you to behold the Cosmic Form. All beings and entities are there. The fat and the lean? the…

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text: ।।11.5।। व्याख्या--'पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः'--अर्जुनकी संकोचपूर्वक प्रार्थनाको सुनकर भगवान् अत्यधिक प्रसन्न हुए; अतः अर्जुनके लिये 'पार्थ' सम्बोधनका प्रयोग करते हुए कहते हैं कि तू मेरे रूपोंको देख। रूपोंमें भी तीन-चार नहीं, प्रत्युत सैकड़ों-हजारों रूपोंको देख अर्थात् अनगिनत रूपोंको देख। भगवान्ने जैसे विभूतियोंके विषय कहा है कि मेरी विभूतियोंका अन्त नहीं आ सकता, ऐसे ही यहाँ भगवान्ने,अपने रूपोंकी अनन्तता बतायी है।

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 11.5 पश्य behold? मे My? पार्थ O Partha? रूपाणि forms? शतशः by hundreds? अथ and? सहस्रशः by thousands? नानाविधानि of different sorts? दिव्यानि divine? नानावर्णाकृतीनि of various colours and shapes? च and.Commentary Divyani Divine supernatural.Satasah? Sahasrasah By the hundreds and thousands -- countless.O Arjuna? I want you to behold the Cosmic Form. All beings and entities are there. The fat and the lean? the short and the tall? the red and the black? the active and the passive? the rich and the poor? the intelligent and the dull? the healthy and the sick? the noisy and the silent? those that are awake? those that are asleep? the beautiful and the ugly? and all grades of beings with their distinctive marks are all there. The blueness of the sky? the yellowness of the silk? the redness of the twilight? the blackness of the coal? the whiteness of the snow? and the greenness of the…

verses.title: Verse 420
verses.sanskrit:
पश्यादित्यान्वसून्रुद्रानश्िवनौ मरुतस्तथा।

बहून्यदृष्टपूर्वाणि पश्याऽश्चर्याणि भारत।।11.6।।
verses.transliteration:
paśhyādityān vasūn rudrān aśhvinau marutas tathā
bahūny adṛiṣhṭa-pūrvāṇi paśhyāśhcharyāṇi bhārata
verses.wordMeanings: paśhya—behold; ādityān—the (twelve) sons of Aditi; vasūn—the (eight) Vasus; rudrān—the (eleven) Rudras; aśhvinau—the (twin) Ashvini Kumars; marutaḥ—the (forty-nine) Maruts; tathā—and; bahūni—many; adṛiṣhṭa—never revealed; pūrvāṇi—before; paśhya—behold; āśhcharyāṇi—marvels; bhārata—Arjun, scion of the Bharatas

translations.hindi: ।।11.6।। हे भारत ! (मुझमें) आदित्यों, वसुओं, रुद्रों तथा अश्विनीकुमारों और मरुद्गणों को देखो, तथा और भी अनेक इसके पूर्व कभी न देखे हुए आश्चर्यों को देखो।।
translations.english: Behold, O Arjuna, the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the two Asvins, and the Maruts—many marvels never seen before.

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।11.6।। हे भरतवंशोद्भव अर्जुन! तू बारह आदित्योंको, आठ वसुओंको, ग्यारह रुद्रोंको और दो अश्विनीकुमारोंको तथा उनचास मरुद्गणोंको देख। जिनको तूने पहले कभी देखा नहीं, ऐसे बहुत-से आश्चर्यजनक रूपोंको भी तू देख।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।11.6।। हे भारत ! (मुझमें) आदित्यों, वसुओं, रुद्रों तथा अश्विनीकुमारों और मरुद्गणों को देखो, तथा और भी अनेक इसके पूर्व कभी न देखे हुए आश्चर्यों को देखो।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: Behold, O Arjuna, the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the two Asvins, and the Maruts—many marvels never seen before.

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: Behold the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the two Ashvins, and the Maruts. O scion of the Bharata dynasty, also behold the many wonders that have never been seen before.

verses.editorialSummary: Behold, O Arjuna, the Adityas, the Vasus, the Rudras, the two Asvins, and the Maruts—many marvels never seen before.
verses.commentary: 11.6 पश्य behold? आदित्यान् the Adityas? वसून् the Vasus? रुद्रान् the Rudras? अश्िवनौ the (two) Asvins? मरुतः the Maruts? तथा also? बहूनि many? अदृष्टपूर्वाणि never seen before? पश्य see? आश्चर्याणि wonders? भारत O Bharata.Commentary Adityas? Vasus? Rudras and Maruts have already been described in the previous chapter.Not these alone Behold also many other wonders never seen before by you or anybody else in this…

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text:
।।11.6।। व्याख्या--'पश्यादित्यान्वसून्रुद्रानश्विनौ मरुतस्तथा'-- अदितिके पुत्र धाता, मित्र, अर्यमा, शुक्र, वरुण, अंश, भग, विवस्वान्, पूषा, सविता, त्वष्टा और विष्णु -- ये बारह 'आदित्य' हैं (महा0 आदि0 65। 15 16)।

धर, ध्रुव, सोम, अहः, अनिल, अनल, प्रत्यूष और प्रभास --ये आठ वसु हैं (महा0 आदि0 66। 18)।हर, बहुरूप, त्रयम्बक, अपराजित, वृषाकपि, शम्भु, कपर्दी, रैवतमृगव्याध, शर्व और कपाली -- ये ग्यारह 'रुद्र' हैं (हरिवंश0 1। 3। 51 52)।'अश्विनीकुमार' दो हैं। ये दोनों भाई देवताओंके वैद्य हैं।सत्त्वज्योति, आदित्य, सत्यज्योति, तिर्यग्ज्योति, सज्योति, ज्योतिष्मान्, हरित, ऋतजित्, सत्यजित्, सुषेण, सेनजित्, सत्यमित्र, अभिमित्र, हरिमित्र, कृत, सत्य, ध्रुव, धर्ता, विधर्ता, विधारय, ध्वान्त, धुनि, उग्र, भीम, अभियु, साक्षिप, ईदृक्, अन्यादृक्, यादृक्, प्रतिकृत्, ऋक्, समिति, संरम्भ, ईदृक्ष, पुरुष, अन्यादृक्ष, चेतस, समिता, समिदृक्षप्रतिदृक्ष, मरुति, सरत, देव, दिश, यजुः, अनुदृक्, साम, मानुष और विश् -- ये उनचास…

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 11.6 पश्य behold? आदित्यान् the Adityas? वसून् the Vasus? रुद्रान् the Rudras? अश्िवनौ the (two) Asvins? मरुतः the Maruts? तथा also? बहूनि many? अदृष्टपूर्वाणि never seen before? पश्य see? आश्चर्याणि wonders? भारत O Bharata.Commentary Adityas? Vasus? Rudras and Maruts have already been described in the previous chapter.Not these alone Behold also many other wonders never seen before by you or anybody else in this world.

verses.title: Verse 421
verses.sanskrit:
इहैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं पश्याद्य सचराचरम्।

मम देहे गुडाकेश यच्चान्यद्द्रष्टुमिच्छसि।।11.7।।
verses.transliteration:
ihaika-sthaṁ jagat kṛitsnaṁ paśhyādya sa-charācharam
mama dehe guḍākeśha yach chānyad draṣhṭum ichchhasi
verses.wordMeanings: iha—here; eka-stham—assembled together; jagat—the universe; kṛitsnam—entire; paśhya—behold; adya—now; sa—with; chara—the moving; acharam—the non- moving; mama—my; dehe—in this form; guḍākeśha—Arjun, the conqueror of sleep; yat—whatever; cha—also; anyat—else; draṣhṭum—to see; ichchhasi—you wish

translations.hindi: ।।11.7।। हे गुडाकेश ! आज (अब) इस मेरे शरीर में एक स्थान पर स्थित हुए चराचर सहित सम्पूर्ण जगत् को देखो तथा और भी जो कुछ तुम देखना चाहते हो, उसे भी देखो।।
translations.english: Behold here, O Arjuna, the entire universe with its mobile and immobile things, all centered in My body, and whatever else you desire to see.

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।11.7।। हे नींदको जीतनेवाले अर्जुन! मेरे इस शरीरके एक देशमें चराचरसहित सम्पूर्ण जगत् को अभी देख ले। इसके सिवाय तू और भी जो कुछ देखना चाहता है, वह भी देख ले।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।11.7।। हे गुडाकेश ! आज (अब) इस मेरे शरीर में एक स्थान पर स्थित हुए चराचर सहित सम्पूर्ण जगत् को देखो तथा और भी जो कुछ तुम देखना चाहते हो, उसे भी देखो।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: Behold here, O Arjuna, the entire universe with its mobile and immobile things, all centered in My body, and whatever else you desire to see.

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: See now, O Gudakesa, the entire Universe together with the moving and the non-moving, concentrated in the same place here in My body, as also whatever else you would like to see.

verses.editorialSummary: Behold here, O Arjuna, the entire universe with its mobile and immobile things, all centered in My body, and whatever else you desire to see.
verses.commentary: 11.7 इह in this? एकस्थम् centred in one? जगत् the universe? कृत्स्नम् whole? पश्य behold? अद्य now? सचराचरम् with the moving and the unmoving? मम My? देहे in body? गुडाकेश O Gudakesa? यत् whatever? च and? अन्यत् other? द्रष्टुम् to see? इच्छसि (thou) desirest.Commentary Anyat Other whatever else. Your success or defeat in the war? about which you,have entertained a doubt. (Cf.II.6)

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text: ।।11.7।। व्याख्या--गुडाकेश'--निद्रापर अधिकार प्राप्त करनेसे अर्जुनको 'गुडाकेश' कहते हैं। यहाँ यह सम्बोधन देनेका तात्पर्य है कि तू निरालस्य होकर सावधानीसे मेरे विश्व-रूपको देख।

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 11.7 इह in this? एकस्थम् centred in one? जगत् the universe? कृत्स्नम् whole? पश्य behold? अद्य now? सचराचरम् with the moving and the unmoving? मम My? देहे in body? गुडाकेश O Gudakesa? यत् whatever? च and? अन्यत् other? द्रष्टुम् to see? इच्छसि (thou) desirest.Commentary Anyat Other whatever else. Your success or defeat in the war? about which you,have entertained a doubt. (Cf.II.6)

verses.title: Verse 422
verses.sanskrit:
न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा।

दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्।।11.8।।
verses.transliteration:
na tu māṁ śhakyase draṣhṭum anenaiva sva-chakṣhuṣhā
divyaṁ dadāmi te chakṣhuḥ paśhya me yogam aiśhwaram
verses.wordMeanings: na—not; tu—but; mām—me; śhakyase—you can; draṣhṭum—to see; anena—with these; eva—even; sva-chakṣhuṣhā—with your physical eyes; divyam—divine; dadāmi—I give; te—to you; chakṣhuḥ—eyes; paśhya—behold; me—my; yogam aiśhwaram—majestic opulence

translations.hindi: ।।11.8।। परन्तु तुम अपने इन्हीं (प्राकृत) नेत्रों के द्वारा मुझे देखने में समर्थ नहीं हो; (इसलिए) मैं तुम्हें दिव्यचक्षु देता हूँ, जिससे तुम मेरे ईश्वरीय 'योग' को देखो।।
translations.english: But you will not be able to see Me with your own eyes. I give you a divine eye, so behold My Lordly Yoga!

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।11.8।। परन्तु तू अपनी इस आँखसे अर्थात् चर्मचक्षुसे मेरेको देख ही नहीं सकता, इसलिये मैं तुझे दिव्य चक्षु देता हूँ, जिससे तू मेरी ईश्वर-सम्बन्धी सामर्थ्यको देख।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।11.8।। परन्तु तुम अपने इन्हीं (प्राकृत) नेत्रों के द्वारा मुझे देखने में समर्थ नहीं हो; (इसलिए) मैं तुम्हें दिव्यचक्षु देता हूँ, जिससे तुम मेरे ईश्वरीय 'योग' को देखो।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: But you will not be able to see Me with your own eyes. I give you a divine eye, so behold My Lordly Yoga!

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: But you are not able to see Me with just this eye of yours. I grant you the divine eye; behold My divine Yoga.

verses.editorialSummary: But you will not be able to see Me with your own eyes.
verses.commentary: 11.8 न not? तु but? माम् Me? शक्यसे (thou) canst? द्रष्टुम् to see? अनेन with this? एव even? स्वचक्षुषा with own eyes? दिव्यम् divine? ददामि (I) give? ते (to) thee? चक्षुः the eye? पश्य behold? मे My? योगम् Yoga? ऐश्वरम् lordly.Commentary No fleshly eyes can behold Me in My Cosmic Form. One can see It through the divine eye or the eye of intuition. It should not be confused with seeing through the eye or the mind.…

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text: ।।11.8।। व्याख्या--'न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा'--तुम्हारे जो चर्मचक्षु हैं, इनकी शक्ति बहुत अल्प और सीमित है। प्राकृत होनेके कारण ये चर्मचक्षु केवल प्रकृतिके तुच्छ कार्यको ही देख सकते हैं अर्थात् प्राकृत मनुष्य, पशु, पक्षी आदिके रूपोंको, उनके भेदोंको तथा धूप-छाया आदिके रूपोंको ही देख सकते हैं। परन्तु वे मन-बुद्धि-इन्द्रियोंसे अतीत मेरे रूपको नहीं देख सकते।

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 11.8 न not? तु but? माम् Me? शक्यसे (thou) canst? द्रष्टुम् to see? अनेन with this? एव even? स्वचक्षुषा with own eyes? दिव्यम् divine? ददामि (I) give? ते (to) thee? चक्षुः the eye? पश्य behold? मे My? योगम् Yoga? ऐश्वरम् lordly.Commentary No fleshly eyes can behold Me in My Cosmic Form. One can see It through the divine eye or the eye of intuition. It should not be confused with seeing through the eye or the mind. It is an inner experience.Lord Krishna says to Arjuna I give thee the divine eye? by which you will be able to behold My sovereign form. By it see My marvellous power of Yoga.Anena With this the fleshly eye or the physical eye? the earthly eye. (Cf.VII.25IX.5X.7)

verses.title: Verse 423
verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच

एवमुक्त्वा ततो राजन्महायोगेश्वरो हरिः।

दर्शयामास पार्थाय परमं रूपमैश्वरम्।।11.9।।
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvācha
evam uktvā tato rājan mahā-yogeśhvaro hariḥ
darśhayām āsa pārthāya paramaṁ rūpam aiśhwaram
verses.wordMeanings: sañjayaḥ uvācha—Sanjay said; evam—thus; uktvā—having spoken; tataḥ—then; rājan—King; mahā-yoga-īśhvaraḥ—the Supreme Lord of Yog; hariḥ—Shree Krishna; darśhayām āsa—displayed; pārthāya—to Arjun; paramam—divine; rūpam aiśhwaram—opulence

translations.hindi: ।।11.9।। संजय ने कहा -- हे राजन् ! महायोगेश्वर हरि ने इस प्रकार कहकर फिर अर्जुन के लिए परम ऐश्वर्ययुक्त रूप को दर्शाया।।
translations.english: Sanjaya said, "O King, having spoken, Sri Krishna, the great Lord of Yoga, then revealed to Arjuna the supreme, lordly form."

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।11.9।। सञ्जय बोले -- हे राजन् ! ऐसा कहकर फिर महायोगेश्वर भगवान् श्रीकृष्णने अर्जुनको परम ऐश्वर-रूप दिखाया।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।11.9।। संजय ने कहा -- हे राजन् ! महायोगेश्वर हरि ने इस प्रकार कहकर फिर अर्जुन के लिए परम ऐश्वर्ययुक्त रूप को दर्शाया।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: Sanjaya said, "O King, having spoken, Sri Krishna, the great Lord of Yoga, then revealed to Arjuna the supreme, lordly form."

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: Sanjaya said, "O King, having spoken thus, thereafter, Hari, the great Master of Yoga, showed to the son of Prtha the supreme divine form."

verses.editorialSummary: Sanjaya said, "O King, having spoken, Sri Krishna, the great Lord of Yoga, then revealed to Arjuna the supreme, lordly form."
verses.commentary: 11.9 एवम् thus? उक्त्वा having spoken? ततः then? राजन् O king? महायोगेश्वरः the great Lord of Yoga? हरिः Hari? दर्शयामास showed? पार्थाय to Arjuna? परमम् Supreme? रूपम् form? ऐश्वरम् Sovereign.Commentary King This verse is addressed by Sanjaya to Dhritarashtra.Supreme Form The Cosmic Form.

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text:
।।11.9।। व्याख्या--'एवमुक्त्वा ततो ৷৷. परमं रूपमैश्वरम्'--पूर्वश्लोकमें भगवान्ने जो यह कहा था कि 'तू अपने चर्मचक्षुओंसे मुझे नहीं देख सकता, इसलिये मैं तेरेको दिव्यचक्षु देता हूँ, जिससे तू मेरे ईश्वर-सम्बन्धी योगको देख' उसीका संकेत यहाँ सञ्जयने 'एवमुक्त्वा' पदसे किया है।चौथे श्लोकमें अर्जुनने भगवान्को 'योगेश्वर' कहा और यहाँ सञ्जय भगवान्को 'महायोगेश्वर' कहते हैं। इसका तात्पर्य है कि भगवान्ने अर्जुनकी प्रार्थनासे बहुत अधिक अपना विश्वरूप दिखाया। भक्तकी थोड़ी-सी भी वास्तविक रुचि भगवान्की तरफ होनेपर भगवान् अपनी अपार शक्तिसे उसकी पूर्ति कर देते हैं।

तीसरे श्लोकमें अर्जुनने जिस रूपके लिये 'रूपमैश्वरम्' कहा, उसी रूपके लिये यहाँ सञ्जय 'परमं रूपमैश्वरम्' कहते हैं। इसका तात्पर्य है कि भगवान्का विश्वरूप बहुत ही विलक्षण है। सम्पूर्ण योगोंके महान् ईश्वर भगवान् श्रीकृष्णने ऐसा विलक्षण, अलौकिक, अद्भुत विश्वरूप दिखाया, जिसको धैर्यशाली, जितेन्द्रिय, शूरवीर और भगवान्से प्राप्त दिव्यदृष्टिवाले अर्जुनको भी…

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 11.9 एवम् thus? उक्त्वा having spoken? ततः then? राजन् O king? महायोगेश्वरः the great Lord of Yoga? हरिः Hari? दर्शयामास showed? पार्थाय to Arjuna? परमम् Supreme? रूपम् form? ऐश्वरम् Sovereign.Commentary King This verse is addressed by Sanjaya to Dhritarashtra.Supreme Form The Cosmic Form.

verses.title: Verse 424
verses.sanskrit:
अनेकवक्त्रनयनमनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम्।

अनेकदिव्याभरणं दिव्यानेकोद्यतायुधम्।।11.10।।
verses.transliteration:
aneka-vaktra-nayanam anekādbhuta-darśhanam
aneka-divyābharaṇaṁ divyānekodyatāyudham
verses.wordMeanings: aneka—many; vaktra—faces; nayanam—eyes; aneka—many; adbhuta—wonderful; darśhanam—had a vision of; aneka—many; divya—divine; ābharaṇam—ornaments; divya—divine; aneka—many; udyata—uplifted; āyudham—weapons;

translations.hindi: ।।11.10।। उस अनेक मुख और नेत्रों से युक्त तथा अनेक अद्भुत दर्शनों वाले एवं बहुत से दिव्य भूषणों से युक्त और बहुत से दिव्य शस्त्रों को हाथों में उठाये हुये।।
translations.english: With innumerable mouths and eyes, many marvelous aspects, numerous divine ornaments, and numerous divine weapons.

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।11.10 -- 11.11।। जिसके अनेक मुख और नेत्र हैं, अनेक तहरके अद्भुत दर्शन हैं, अनेक दिव्य आभूषण हैं, हाथोंमें उठाये हुए अनेक दिव्य आयुध हैं तथा जिनके गलेमें दिव्य मालाएँ हैं, जो दिव्य वस्त्र पहने हुए हैं, जिनके ललाट तथा शरीरपर दिव्य चन्दन, कुंकुम आदि लगा हुआ है, ऐसे सम्पूर्ण आश्चर्यमय, अनन्तरूपवाले तथा चारों तरफ मुखवाले देव-(अपने दिव्य स्वरूप-) को भगवान् ने दिखाया।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।11.10।। उस अनेक मुख और नेत्रों से युक्त तथा अनेक अद्भुत दर्शनों वाले एवं बहुत से दिव्य भूषणों से युक्त और बहुत से दिव्य शस्त्रों को हाथों में उठाये हुये।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: With innumerable mouths and eyes, many marvelous aspects, numerous divine ornaments, and numerous divine weapons.

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: Having many faces and eyes, possessing many wondrous sights, adorned with numerous celestial ornaments, and holding many uplifted heavenly weapons;

verses.editorialSummary: With innumerable mouths and eyes, many marvelous aspects, numerous divine ornaments, and numerous divine weapons.
verses.commentary: 11.10 अनेकवक्त्रनयनम् with numerous mouthsand eyes? अनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम् with numerous wonderful sights? अनेकदिव्याभरणम् with numerous divine ornaments? दिव्यानेकोद्यतायुधम् with numerous divine weapons uplifted.Commentary Countless faces appeared there. Arjuna looked at this Cosmic Form in all its magnificence. He saw the Lord everywhere and in everything. The whole manifestation appeared as one gigantic body of the…

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text: ।।11.10।। व्याख्या--'अनेकवक्त्रनयनम्'--विराट्रूपसे प्रकट हुए भगवान्के जितने मुख और नेत्र दीख रहे हैं, वे सब-के-सब दिव्य हैं। विराट्रूपमें जितने प्राणी दीख रहे हैं, उनके मुख, नेत्र, हाथ, पैर आदि सबकेसब अङ्ग विराट्रूप भगवान्के हैं। कारण कि भगवान् स्वयं ही विराट्रूपसे प्रकट हुए हैं।

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 11.10 अनेकवक्त्रनयनम् with numerous mouthsand eyes? अनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम् with numerous wonderful sights? अनेकदिव्याभरणम् with numerous divine ornaments? दिव्यानेकोद्यतायुधम् with numerous divine weapons uplifted.Commentary Countless faces appeared there. Arjuna looked at this Cosmic Form in all its magnificence. He saw the Lord everywhere and in everything. The whole manifestation appeared as one gigantic body of the Lord. He saw the Lord as the allinall.

verses.title: Verse 425
verses.sanskrit:
दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम्।

सर्वाश्चर्यमयं देवमनन्तं विश्वतोमुखम्।।11.11।।
verses.transliteration:
divya-mālyāmbara-dharaṁ divya-gandhānulepanam
sarvāśhcharya-mayaṁ devam anantaṁ viśhvato-mukham
verses.wordMeanings: divya—divine; mālya—garlands; āmbara—garments; dharam—wearing; divya—divine; gandha—fragrances; anulepanam—anointed with; sarva—all; āśhcharya-mayam—wonderful; devam—Lord; anantam—unlimited; viśhwataḥ—all sides; mukham—face

translations.hindi: ।।11.11।। दिव्य माला और वस्त्रों को धारण किये हुये और दिव्य गन्ध का लेपन किये हुये एवं समस्त प्रकार के आश्चर्यों से युक्त अनन्त, विश्वतोमुख (विराट् स्वरूप) परम देव (को अर्जुन ने देखा)।।
translations.english: Wearing celestial garlands and raiments, anointed with divine perfumes, full of wonders, resplendent, boundless, and facing all directions.

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।11.10 -- 11.11।। जिसके अनेक मुख और नेत्र हैं, अनेक तहरके अद्भुत दर्शन हैं, अनेक दिव्य आभूषण हैं, हाथोंमें उठाये हुए अनेक दिव्य आयुध हैं तथा जिनके गलेमें दिव्य मालाएँ हैं, जो दिव्य वस्त्र पहने हुए हैं, जिनके ललाट तथा शरीरपर दिव्य चन्दन, कुंकुम आदि लगा हुआ है, ऐसे सम्पूर्ण आश्चर्यमय, अनन्त रूपोंवाले तथा चारों तरफ मुखवाले देव-(अपने दिव्य स्वरूप-) को भगवान् ने दिखाया।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।11.11।। दिव्य माला और वस्त्रों को धारण किये हुये और दिव्य गन्ध का लेपन किये हुये एवं समस्त प्रकार के आश्चर्यों से युक्त अनन्त, विश्वतोमुख (विराट् स्वरूप) परम देव (को अर्जुन ने देखा)।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: Wearing celestial garlands and raiments, anointed with divine perfumes, full of wonders, resplendent, boundless, and facing all directions.

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: Wearing heavenly garlands and apparel, anointed with heavenly scents, abounding in all kinds of wonders, resplendent, infinite, and with faces on all sides.

verses.editorialSummary: Wearing celestial garlands and raiments, anointed with divine perfumes, full of wonders, resplendent, boundless, and facing all directions.
verses.commentary: 11.11 दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरम् wearing divine garlands (necklaces) and apparel? दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम् anointed with divine unguents? सर्वाश्चर्यमयम् the allwonderful? देवम् resplendent? अनन्तम् endless? विश्वतोमुखम् with faces on all sides.Commentary Visvatomukham With faces on all sides? as He is the Self of all beings.Devam God. Also means resplendent.Anantam Endless. He Who is free from the three kinds of limitations?…

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text: ।।11.11।। व्याख्या--'अनेकवक्त्रनयनम्'--विराट्रूपसे प्रकट हुए भगवान्के जितने मुख और नेत्र दीख रहे हैं, वे सब-के-सब दिव्य हैं। विराट्रूपमें जितने प्राणी दीख रहे हैं, उनके मुख, नेत्र, हाथ, पैर आदि सब-के-सब अङ्ग विराट्रूप भगवान्के हैं। कारण कि भगवान् स्वयं ही विराट्रूपसे प्रकट हुए हैं।

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 11.11 दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरम् wearing divine garlands (necklaces) and apparel? दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम् anointed with divine unguents? सर्वाश्चर्यमयम् the allwonderful? देवम् resplendent? अनन्तम् endless? विश्वतोमुखम् with faces on all sides.Commentary Visvatomukham With faces on all sides? as He is the Self of all beings.Devam God. Also means resplendent.Anantam Endless. He Who is free from the three kinds of limitations? viz.? DesaKalaVastuPariccheda (limitations of space? time? and thing respectively) is Anantam. He is Brahman. This philosophical concept is explained below.The pot is here. This is spacelimitatio. The pot is now here. This is timelimitation. The pot is not a cloth. This is thing(material) limitation. There is saffron in Kashmir only. This is limitation of space and thing. You can have apples only in September. This is limitation of time and thing. But Brahman is everywhere? as…

verses.title: Verse 426
verses.sanskrit:
दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य भवेद्युगपदुत्थिता।

यदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः।।11.12।।
verses.transliteration:
divi sūrya-sahasrasya bhaved yugapad utthitā
yadi bhāḥ sadṛiśhī sā syād bhāsas tasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.wordMeanings: divi—in the sky; sūrya—suns; sahasrasya—thousand; bhavet—were; yugapat—simultaneously; utthitā—rising; yadi—if; bhāḥ—splendor; sadṛiśhī—like; sā—that; syāt—would be; bhāsaḥ—splendor; tasya—of them; mahā-ātmanaḥ—the great personality

translations.hindi: ।।11.12।। आकाश में सहस्र सूर्यों के एक साथ उदय होने से उत्पन्न जो प्रकाश होगा, वह उस (विश्वरूप) परमात्मा के प्रकाश के सदृश होगा।।
translations.english: If a thousand suns were to rise at once in the sky, the resulting splendour would be like the splendour of that mighty One.

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।11.12।। अगर आकाशमें एक साथ हजारों सूर्य उदित हो जायँ, तो भी उन सबका प्रकाश मिलकर उस महात्मा-(विराट् रूप परमात्मा-) के प्रकाशके समान शायद ही हो।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।11.12।। आकाश में सहस्र सूर्यों के एक साथ उदय होने से उत्पन्न जो प्रकाश होगा, वह उस (विश्वरूप) परमात्मा के प्रकाश के सदृश होगा।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: If a thousand suns were to rise at once in the sky, the resulting splendour would be like the splendour of that mighty One.

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: Should the effulgence of a thousand suns blaze forth simultaneously in the sky, that might be akin to the radiance of that exalted One.

verses.editorialSummary: If a thousand suns were to rise at once in the sky, the resulting splendour would be like the splendour of that mighty One.
verses.commentary: 11.12 दिवि in the sky? सूर्यसहस्रस्य of a thousand suns? भवेत् were? युगपत् at once (simultaneously)? उत्थिता arisen? यदि if? भाः splendour? सदृशी like? सा that? स्यात् would be? भासः splendour? तस्य of that? महात्मनः of the mighty Being (great soul).Commentary Divi here means in the Antariksha or the sky.Mahatma here refers to the great Soul or the mighty Being? the Cosmic Form.

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
commentaryOptions.text: ।।11.12।। व्याख्या--'दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य ৷৷. तस्य महात्मनः'--जैसे आकाशमें हजारों तारे एक साथ उदित होनेपर भी उन सबका मिला हुआ प्रकाश एक चन्द्रमाके प्रकाशके सदृश नहीं हो सकता और हजारों चन्द्रमाओंका मिला हुआ प्रकाश एक सूर्यके प्रकाशके सदृश नहीं हो सकता, ऐसे ही आकाशमें हजारों सूर्य एक साथ उदित होनेपर भी उन सबका मिला हुआ प्रकाश विराट् भगवान्के प्रकाशके सदृश नहीं हो सकता। तात्पर्य यह हुआ कि हजारों सूर्योंका प्रकाश भी विराट् भगवान्के प्रकाशका उपमेय नहीं हो सकता। इस प्रकर जब हजारों सूर्योंके प्रकाशको उपमेय बनानेमें भी दिव्यदृष्टिवाले सञ्जयको संकोच होता है, तब वह प्रकाश विराट्रूप भगवान्के प्रकाशका उपमान हो ही कैसे सकता है! कारण कि सूर्यका प्रकाश भौतिक है, जब कि विराट् भगवान्का प्रकाश दिव्य है। भौतिक प्रकाश कितना ही बड़ा क्यों न हो,,दिव्य प्रकाशके सामने वह तुच्छ ही है। भौतिक प्रकाश और दिव्य प्रकाशकी जाति अलग-अलग होनेसे उनकी आपसमें तुलना नहीं की जा सकती। हाँ, अङ्गुलिनिर्देशकी तरह भौतिक प्रकाशसे…

commentaryOptions.author: Swami Sivananda
commentaryOptions.text: 11.12 दिवि in the sky? सूर्यसहस्रस्य of a thousand suns? भवेत् were? युगपत् at once (simultaneously)? उत्थिता arisen? यदि if? भाः splendour? सदृशी like? सा that? स्यात् would be? भासः splendour? तस्य of that? महात्मनः of the mighty Being (great soul).Commentary Divi here means in the Antariksha or the sky.Mahatma here refers to the great Soul or the mighty Being? the Cosmic Form.

verses.title: Verse 427
verses.sanskrit:
तत्रैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रविभक्तमनेकधा।

अपश्यद्देवदेवस्य शरीरे पाण्डवस्तदा।।11.13।।
verses.transliteration:
tatraika-sthaṁ jagat kṛitsnaṁ pravibhaktam anekadhā
apaśhyad deva-devasya śharīre pāṇḍavas tadā
verses.wordMeanings: tatra—there; eka-stham—established in one place; jagat—the universe; kṛitsnam—entire; pravibhaktam—divided; anekadhā—many; apaśhyat—could see; deva-devasya—of the God of gods; śharīre—in the body; pāṇḍavaḥ—Arjun; tadā—at that time

translations.hindi: ।।11.13।। पाण्डुपुत्र अर्जुन ने उस समय अनेक प्रकार से विभक्त हुए सम्पूर्ण जगत् को देवों के देव श्रीकृष्ण के शरीर में एक स्थान पर स्थित देखा।।
translations.english: There, Arjuna beheld the whole universe, with its manifold divisions gathered together in one single spot within the body of the God of gods.

translationOptions.author: Swami Ramsukhdas
translationOptions.text: ।।11.13।। उस समय अर्जुनने देवोंके देव भगवान् के उस शरीरमें एक जगह स्थित अनेक प्रकारके विभागोंमें विभक्त सम्पूर्ण जगत् को देखा।

translationOptions.author: Swami Tejomayananda
translationOptions.text: ।।11.13।। पाण्डुपुत्र अर्जुन ने उस समय अनेक प्रकार से विभक्त हुए सम्पूर्ण जगत् को देवों के देव श्रीकृष्ण के शरीर में एक स्थान पर स्थित देखा।।

translationOptions.author: Swami Adidevananda
translationOptions.text: There, Arjuna beheld the whole universe, with its manifold divisions gathered together in one single spot within the body of the God of gods.

translationOptions.author: Swami Gambirananda
translationOptions.text: At that time, the Pandava saw, in the body of the God of gods, the whole diversely differentiated universe united in one.
